deals.title: Gratis-Eintritt zum Event bei Jesuitenkirche
deals.description: Breathe in history, breathe out the present. 🕊️ A little joyride through Vienna's Old Town in a vintage e-car led me to Dr.-Ignaz-Seipel-Platz - the old university quarter from the 1420s. There stands the Jesuit Church (Jesuitenkirche), also called the University Church. Built 1623-1627, dedicated to St. Ignatius Loyola & St. Francis Xavier, and transformed in 1703 by Jesuit artist Andrea Pozzo. Twin towers outside, and inside a flat ceiling painted to look like heaven itself is opening. It was built to remind people to look up, to feel something bigger. 400 years later, it still does. Vienna is full of palaces, but sometimes the real landmark is the moment of stillness you find inside them. 📍 Jesuitenkirche, Vienna | Free entry | 2 mins from St. Stephen's Cathedral #wien #viennaoldtown #jesuitenkirche #viennaaustria🇦🇹 #viennatravel
